citation.journal: Journal of Clinical and Aesthetic Dermatology

record.population: Review of treatment options in skin of colour
record.finding: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation tends to affect darker skin more often and more severely. Treatment should begin early, starting with management of the original inflammation. First-line therapy is typically topical depigmenting agents plus photoprotection including sunscreen. The authors warn to use caution with all treatments to avoid irritation and worsening of the pigmentation.
